entities.name: Lucius Aelius Stilo Praeconinus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucius Aelius Stilo Praeconinus, of Lanuvium, was the earliest known philologist of the Roman Republic. He came from a distinguished family and belonged to the equestrian order.
